# The George-Anne Media Group

> > Student news and sports coverage from Georgia Southern University in Statesboro, Georgia

The George-Anne is the official student media organization covering GSU Eagles athletics, campus news, and Statesboro community events. Coverage focuses heavily on Southern Conference sports including football, basketball, volleyball, and other NCAA Division I athletics, alongside campus safety, student life, and local developments.

## Key Topics

- Georgia Southern University (GSU)
- GSU Eagles Athletics
- Southern Conference (SoCon)
- Statesboro, Georgia
- College Football & FBS Expansion
- Men's & Women's Basketball
- Volleyball
- Campus Safety & Public Safety
- Rivalry Games (Appalachian State)
- Allen E. Paulson Stadium
- Student Life & Campus Events
- Athletic Rankings & Championships
- Player Spotlights & Academic Honors
- Game Recaps & Previews
